title: How to Build a Subscription App with Stripe: Complete Guide 2026
summary: A step-by-step guide to building a subscription SaaS with Stripe — covering auth, Stripe Checkout, webhooks, plan tiers, customer portal, and failed payment handling. No backend engineering required.
body_markdown: Blink generates middleware that reads` user.plan` from the database and gates access to paid features. For API endpoints, the middleware returns a 403 with an upgrade prompt if the user's plan does not include the feature. For UI, the dashboard shows upgrade prompts at feature limits. Every limit check reads from the database — never from a client-side variable that users could manipulate.
